channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran squad in race against time for World Cup readiness amid US-Israel war
item.description: With Iran's local football league suspended since March, most players in the squad have not been in action for months.

item.title: Child survivor of San Diego mosque shooting describes ordeal
item.description: A boy who survived the San Diego mosque shooting that killed three people has described seeing ‘bad stuff’.

item.title: Los Angeles World Cup stadium workers threaten strike over ICE deployment
item.description: Workers represented by a local union say ICE presence would create a climate of fear during the FIFA World Cup 2026.

item.title: Russian strike damages Ukraine Danube port as Moscow intercepts drones
item.description: Russia also plans military exercises as Putin prepares for Beijing visit.

item.title: Iran war day 81: Trump delays attack; Tehran says won’t ‘surrender’
item.description: US president says he held off a scheduled attack on Iran after pressure from Gulf allies as renewed talks gain momentum.

item.title: Trump says he called off new Iran attack at request of Gulf states
item.description: The US president says he is holding off on an attack planned for Tuesday as "serious negotiations are now taking place".

item.title: Death toll from Israeli strikes on Lebanon passes 3,000, officials say
item.description: It marks a grim milestone in the conflict between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since March, despite a nominal ceasefire.

item.title: Four killed in protests during Kenyan strikes over high fuel prices
item.description: Thousands of commuters are stranded, with key roads in the capital Nairobi largely empty due to the protests over fuel costs.

item.title: Israeli forces board Gaza-bound flotilla near Cyprus, activists say
item.description: The Global Sumud Flotilla says commandos have intercepted more than 40 boats trying to breach the Gaza maritime blockade since Tuesday.

item.title: Trump warns 'clock is ticking' for Iran as peace progress stalls
item.description: On Monday Iran said it had responded to the latest US proposal and that exchanges with Washington were continuing.
